## Featured project

### [FlowPulse](https://github.com/manu-javadev/flowpulse): Payout & Batch Processing Platform

A microservices payout and batch processing platform built with Java 17 and Spring Boot.

- Secure CSV ingestion, multi-level approvals and high-volume financial transactions
- Event-driven processing with RabbitMQ, Spring Retry (exponential backoff) and Dead Letter Queues, so failed bank gateway calls are retried without losing data
- Spring Security with stateless JWT, refresh token rotation and role-based access control
- Faster database access by fixing N+1 queries and Hibernate lazy-loading errors with DTO mapping
- React + TypeScript dashboard, shipped through GitHub Actions CI/CD to Docker on AWS

`Java 17` `Spring Boot` `Spring Security` `Spring Cloud` `PostgreSQL` `RabbitMQ` `React` `Docker` `AWS`
